news.headline: The 10th JDC and Reconnect: A Case Study in Action

paragraphs: Reconnect, Inc. sells software and hardware that connect specialty courts, pretrial, and community supervision programs with their participants. The pages say the solutions are used by drug courts, probation, parole, and TPAs.

The Client Mobile App provides daily tasks for clients. Case managers create calendar events for participants in Reconnect Manager. Location monitoring is sold as an add-on feature named HardwareFreeEM. The solutions page states that location monitoring is not a default feature and is available only when ordered by a court program.

Drug test randomization can run automatically or be adapted to weekly program needs. Smartphone leasing is offered for clients who do not have a phone. Reconnect eSignature covers electronic forms and document workflows for behavioral health and human services programs.

quote.text: Software and hardware to connect specialty courts, pretrial, and community supervision programs with their participants.
